_comment: Shared device-side AFX reference catalog seeded from Gazelle measurements and public effect descriptions. Device capacity stays in device profiles. Shared control names are declared metadata; Orion Memory Cat Brigade has capture-observed field mappings, kept separate from verified writable encodings. Every load/recall/parameter command is null. Model-local type IDs are capture/readback observations, kept separate from runtime instance indices. Captured Orion write discriminators still require live pilot verification. Runtime instances are never catalog IDs. No runtime loader or writer consumes this catalog.

provenance.notes: Gazelle documents 80 named types within a 90-entry enumeration on Discrete 4 Synergy Core; the remaining unnamed types are omitted. The declaration-derived control names do not establish their ranges, packing, or a write contract. Names not matched to public product documentation retain the Gazelle source name; product descriptions and categories remain null until established.

evidence: Owner clarified action order and six knob endpoints (0-100) on 2026-09-30.
implementations.notes: Orion-only observation from owned-device HID OUT traffic and owner-labelled actions. The new eight-instance capture establishes type ID 73 and a separate instance index: chain slots are {type, inst} pairs at bytes 19-34; parameter frames address type at 18 and instance at 19. Instance 4 retains its identity through reordering; the owner set its Level to 0 (frames 49667/49719). Report offsets exclude USB capture headers. Six knobs reach raw 0 and 100; intermediate display scaling, quantization and physical units remain unverified. Switch label polarity and effect-parameter readback remain unknown. Commands here remain null; explicitly bounded test operations belong to the Orion runtime contract, not a cross-device catalog writer.
